variation: Glute-ham raise on a GHD with secured feet, thigh-pad contact, knee extension during lowering and hamstring-led return; no waist-only back extension.
camera: Fixed side three-quarter facing left, full GHD and athlete visible.
equipment: Rigid GHD with rounded thigh pads, ankle rollers and footplate; no added weight.

beats.label: Set upright
beats.cue: Secure feet; brace with arms across chest.
beats.pose: Upright, thighs against pad, feet secured between ankle rollers and footplate.

beats.label: Begin lowering
beats.cue: Lower slowly by extending at your knees.
beats.pose: Body leans forward about25degrees, hips extended, knees remain supported.

beats.label: Control your range
beats.cue: Keep knees, hips and head aligned.
beats.pose: Controlled forward lean about45degrees, no waist-only hinge.

beats.label: Stay braced
beats.cue: Keep hips extended and hamstrings under tension.

beats.label: Curl upward
beats.cue: Use hamstrings and glutes to rise smoothly.

beats.label: Return upright
beats.cue: Finish tall without arching your lower back.
